title: Reverse the Word Order
prompt: A note-taking app needs a quick way to flip the order of words in a sentence. Given a sentence with single spaces between words, write a function that returns the words in reverse order joined by single spaces.

explanation.beginner:
Example: reverseWords("hello world") produces "world hello". The result must follow this precise rule: A note-taking app needs a quick way to flip the order of words in a sentence. Given a sentence with single spaces between words, write a function that returns the words in reverse order joined by single spaces. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “reverses several words”: input ["the quick brown fox"] produces "fox brown quick the". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
